design_overview: A clean, modern task management application designed with clarity and usability at its core. The interface uses a card-based layout with strong visual hierarchy, making task creation, completion, and deletion intuitive. The design follows iOS/Android native patterns with bottom navigation, touch-friendly components, and clear action buttons. Color coding distinguishes completed from incomplete tasks, while subtle animations provide feedback. The UI prioritizes quick task entry and effortless status updates.

typography.font_family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

key_components.name: Create Task Button

responsive_design: The application uses a mobile-first approach optimized for 375px-428px width screens (iOS/Android phones). Components scale proportionally on larger screens. Bottom navigation remains fixed for easy thumb access. Cards and lists use full width with 16px horizontal margins. Text inputs expand to fill available width. The layout uses flexbox for vertical stacking and maintains consistent 16px spacing between elements. On tablets (768px+), the app uses a two-column layout with task list on left and detail view on right.
accessibility: All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets. Color contrast ratios meet WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for text). Form inputs include visible labels and error messages. Focus states are clearly indicated with primary color borders. Screen reader labels are provided for all icons and buttons. Semantic HTML ensures proper navigation order. Error messages are announced to screen readers. Success/error states use both color and icons for color-blind users. Font sizes are scalable and respect system settings.
animations: Smooth transitions enhance usability without distraction. Screen navigation uses 300ms slide animations (left/right for stack navigation, up/down for modals). Button presses show 100ms scale-down effect (0.95). Checkbox completion animates with 200ms spring effect. Task cards slide in with 150ms stagger on list load. FAB rotates 45° when tapped. Loading states use subtle pulse animations. Toast notifications slide down from top over 250ms. Swipe actions reveal with rubber-band physics. All animations respect system reduce-motion preferences.
icons: Icons use a consistent 24px size throughout the app from a cohesive icon set (Lucide or SF Symbols style). Primary icons include: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), user (person silhouette), settings (gear), bell (notification bell), bookmark (ribbon), heart (outline heart), filter (funnel), plus (plus sign), edit (pencil), trash (trash bin), share (share arrow). Icons are monochrome, matching text color or using primary/success/error colors for semantic meaning. All icons have 2px stroke weight for visual consistency.
